title: Framework (fd.c): implement FINALIZE, dynamic outbuf, non-finalizing read()
description:
Core framework changes in src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c:

1. FINALIZE ioctl handler:
   - Call ops->fips_gate() if set
   - Call ops->finalize(ctx, outbuf tail, remaining cap, &outlen)
   - Append finalize output to outbuf
   - Set finalized=true
   - Return 0 or error

2. read() changes:
   - Do NOT call finalize() on read (remove lines 346-367 auto-finalize logic)
   - Simply drain outbuf_drained..outbuf_len to userspace
   - Return 0 (EOF) only if finalized=true AND outbuf fully drained
   - If not finalized and outbuf empty, return 0 (caller tries again after more writes)

3. outbuf allocation:
   - Remove the upfront 1MB kmalloc in outbuf_ensure()
   - Replace with dynamic growth: start at 4096, krealloc as update() produces output
   - Cap at CRYPTO2DEV_OUTBUF_MAX (existing constant) as a hard ceiling
   - Size for hash operations stays at CRYPTO2DEV_HASH_MAXLEN (64 bytes) — no change needed

4. write() changes:
   - After calling ops->update(), append any output to outbuf (dynamic resize if needed)
   - Keep existing finalized check: write() after FINALIZE returns -EINVAL

Thread safety: all changes under existing state->lock.
